find_package(linux-headers-generic REQUIRED)

add_subdirectory(unittests)
add_subdirectory(benchmarks)

add_library(extensions-clickhouse-cpp)


target_compile_options(extensions-clickhouse-cpp PRIVATE
  -Wdeprecated-this-capture
  -Wimplicit-fallthrough
  -Wparentheses
  -Wno-logical-op-parentheses
  -Wno-bitwise-op-parentheses
  -Wswitch
  -Wreturn-type
)

target_link_libraries(extensions-clickhouse-cpp PUBLIC
  linux-headers-generic::linux-headers-generic
  contrib-libs-cxxsupp
  yutil
  contrib-libs-clickhouse-cpp
  cpp-yt-farmhash
  library-cpp-common
  library-cpp-computation
  cpp-connectors-common
)

target_sources(extensions-clickhouse-cpp PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/yt/yt/flow/extensions/clickhouse/cpp/block_builder.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/yt/yt/flow/extensions/clickhouse/cpp/describe_traits.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/yt/yt/flow/extensions/clickhouse/cpp/shard.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/yt/yt/flow/extensions/clickhouse/cpp/sink.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/yt/yt/flow/extensions/clickhouse/cpp/spec.cpp
)

target_compile_options(extensions-clickhouse-cpp.global PRIVATE
  -Wdeprecated-this-capture

  -Wparentheses
  -Wno-logical-op-parentheses
  -Wno-bitwise-op-parentheses

  -Wreturn-type
)
